title: Grumpy Needs Help
reason: Correct dialogue, clarify the rescue action, and let Grumpy genuinely accept help rather than undercutting the book's lesson.

pages.1: Grumpy was stuck. His tail was caught under a big rock.
pages.2: "I do not need help," said Grumpy.
pages.3: "Can I help?" asked Sunny. "No," said Grumpy.
pages.4: "Can I help?" asked Bouncy. "No," said Grumpy. Bouncy stayed close.
pages.5: "Can we help?" asked all the Dino Pals. "No!" said Grumpy.
pages.6: Grumpy pulled and pulled. His tail was still stuck.
pages.7: "Oh, fine," Grumpy said quietly. The Dino Pals pushed together. His tail sprang free!
pages.8: "Thank you," said Grumpy. "I did need some help." He smiled a little.
